title: Quick Roasted Greek Beef Saganaki
description: A buttery and creamy Greek dish featuring roasted beef in a rich unsalted beef stock sauce, perfect for a special occasion. This egg-free friendly recipe is sure to impress your guests.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef strips with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium-high heat and sear the beef strips until browned.
Transfer the beef to a baking dish and roast in the oven for 10 minutes.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and saute the garlic until fragrant.
Add the unsalted beef stock to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the heavy cream.
Add the kalamata olives and feta cheese to the skillet and stir to combine.
Remove the beef from the oven and place it in the skillet with the sauce.
Simmer the beef in the sauce for 2 minutes.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
